Essentials 2.0 · Design research · 04-learner-groups

Adding Learner Groups to Courses

Research for Essentials 2.0 · Semester → Courses → Adding Learner Groups. The retained screens and flow previews compare existing-group inheritance, enrollment review, rosters, bulk entry, limits and notification intent. Course evidence is distinguished from project, event and booking analogues. No retained example establishes live LMS cohort synchronization.

Top examples

  1. Circle · Mobbin — closest course-specific existing-group inheritance control; continuing sync is unproven. Circle mobbin:7fccd8eb-8b47-4eba-9b29-c061ef84f911.
  2. Basecamp · Mobbin — unusually explicit snapshot-membership policy, retained as a counter-example. Basecamp mobbin:03d638de-71a2-4fdd-a4a9-19fb51e82492.
  3. Deel · Mobbin — course assignment puts the selected count and whole-team warning before continuing. Deel mobbin:e490327d-01e5-42c3-a4c7-c27925e5d6c1.
  4. Teachable · Mobbin — manual enrollment and CSV entry live together, with a course target and success feedback. Teachable mobbin:61127de5-672c-4250-984a-73e1c0684ce1.
  5. Gusto · Mobbin — participant selection, completion timing, review, price and email consequences form one pre-purchase flow. Gusto mobbin:9fb5633a-b981-4130-ac7f-bddf895856ae.
  6. Podia · Mobbin — course availability groups start-date and sign-up-limit settings. Podia mobbin:ac312350-012f-49d9-9f95-25365859a6c3.
  7. Luma · Refero — capacity and waitlist policy appear together in an event-admin control. Luma refero:4f821362-5e07-4f2a-9a8d-a63a3330ccdb.
  8. Circle · Mobbin — explicitly choose invitation emails or silent addition. Circle mobbin:e50417f0-d6e6-4ad2-8fdc-bf7b11ff4b79.

What the best apps do differently

  • They clarify a group’s meaning. Circle shows where members are inherited; Basecamp goes further by stating that past assignments do not follow future group changes. Essentials needs that semantic clarity before implementing synchronization. Circle mobbin:7fccd8eb-8b47-4eba-9b29-c061ef84f911; Basecamp mobbin:03d638de-71a2-4fdd-a4a9-19fb51e82492.
  • They put scale into the decision. Deel exposes a whole-team warning and selection count; GitBook names the exact count in its add action. Gusto separates participant selection from scheduling and review. Deel mobbin:e490327d-01e5-42c3-a4c7-c27925e5d6c1; GitBook mobbin:bb97eec3-4564-4fab-a695-555b70cf9245; Gusto mobbin:9fb5633a-b981-4130-ac7f-bddf895856ae.
  • They distinguish different roster jobs. Circle surfaces role/activity or course progress; Teachable supports course filters and bulk operations. None of these examples explains inherited access through group-origin and override labels. Circle mobbin:3e4b87ce-37eb-41e8-af41-026d197eeccc; Circle mobbin:eb1701f1-73e1-45e2-a31f-80df30333517; Teachable mobbin:3b608ec9-63a0-4e82-b915-4535ea70a9ac.
  • They make alternate bulk paths discoverable. Teachable pairs manual entry with CSV; Partiful makes CSV headers, a template and invitee review visible in the preparation surface. Only Teachable is direct course-enrollment evidence. Teachable mobbin:61127de5-672c-4250-984a-73e1c0684ce1; Partiful refero:d19d15c3-daac-4d6e-834f-a128a511a7ba.
  • They put limits beside an explicit policy. Podia shows a course sign-up cap; Luma couples event capacity with a waitlist toggle; Fresha’s booking flow asks for acceptable dates and times. These solve different parts of the capacity problem. Podia mobbin:ac312350-012f-49d9-9f95-25365859a6c3; Luma refero:4f821362-5e07-4f2a-9a8d-a63a3330ccdb; Fresha mobbin:13c4d86b-b5dd-446d-8451-66c17cf96e32.
  • They expose email consequences. Circle names email versus silent addition; Gusto explains the course email and learner next steps before purchase. Cloudflare’s restricted skip-email failure is a counter-example for recoverable enrollment errors. Circle mobbin:e50417f0-d6e6-4ad2-8fdc-bf7b11ff4b79; Gusto mobbin:b1497c40-cdea-4b8a-8e73-6cd70a8fcb2f; Cloudflare mobbin:2e1d62a3-dcef-49da-b7f0-83211a076b8a.

Best practices top companies converge on

The strongest repeated patterns are count-based review, adjacent entry paths and explicit action consequences. The following are proposed applications to Essentials, grounded in the references rather than claims of universal LMS behavior.

  • Show a selected-learner total immediately before confirmation; use a count-bearing enrollment action. Deel mobbin:e490327d-01e5-42c3-a4c7-c27925e5d6c1; GitBook mobbin:bb97eec3-4564-4fab-a695-555b70cf9245; Gusto mobbin:9fb5633a-b981-4130-ac7f-bddf895856ae.
  • Keep manual entry and bulk alternatives reachable from the same enrollment surface. Teachable mobbin:61127de5-672c-4250-984a-73e1c0684ce1; Partiful refero:d19d15c3-daac-4d6e-834f-a128a511a7ba; Circle mobbin:e50417f0-d6e6-4ad2-8fdc-bf7b11ff4b79.
  • Make the enrollment target and access consequences visible before applying the change. Teachable mobbin:61127de5-672c-4250-984a-73e1c0684ce1; Asana mobbin:bb93bc5a-69d4-4f3e-8f70-fa48fb9b6b53.
  • Place course limits and the chosen full-capacity behavior where the instructor can inspect them. Adapt event waitlisting cautiously to groups. Podia mobbin:ac312350-012f-49d9-9f95-25365859a6c3; Luma refero:4f821362-5e07-4f2a-9a8d-a63a3330ccdb.
  • State who receives an enrollment email and when; name silent addition explicitly and retain clear failure feedback. Circle mobbin:e50417f0-d6e6-4ad2-8fdc-bf7b11ff4b79; Gusto mobbin:b1497c40-cdea-4b8a-8e73-6cd70a8fcb2f; Cloudflare mobbin:2e1d62a3-dcef-49da-b7f0-83211a076b8a.

Open questions for Essentials 2.0

  • Should attaching a semester group keep membership synchronized, or copy the current roster? If synchronized, what happens to learner progress and recordings after removal? The examples distinguish inheritance and snapshots but do not settle these rules. Circle mobbin:7fccd8eb-8b47-4eba-9b29-c061ef84f911; Basecamp mobbin:03d638de-71a2-4fdd-a4a9-19fb51e82492.
  • When two groups overlap, should the preview report unique learners, already enrolled learners and net-new seats separately? The retained previews show selected counts, not this delta. Deel mobbin:e490327d-01e5-42c3-a4c7-c27925e5d6c1; GitBook mobbin:bb97eec3-4564-4fab-a695-555b70cf9245.
  • How should instructors see group origin, direct additions and exclusions on one roster? How does an individual exception behave after a later group sync? These fields are not demonstrated. Circle mobbin:3e4b87ce-37eb-41e8-af41-026d197eeccc; Teachable mobbin:3b608ec9-63a0-4e82-b915-4535ea70a9ac.
  • Does capacity apply to the course, a simulation event, or both? If a group will not fit, block the whole group, admit part, or waitlist the group as a unit? The examples handle course limits or individual/event waitlists. Podia mobbin:ac312350-012f-49d9-9f95-25365859a6c3; Luma refero:4f821362-5e07-4f2a-9a8d-a63a3330ccdb; Fresha mobbin:13c4d86b-b5dd-446d-8451-66c17cf96e32.
  • What does an enrollment commit create in the Learner Portal, and which system owns roster changes when Canvas is connected? Should notifications wait for a successful hand-off? Keep message composition in 07/09; invitation controls here do not establish that integration or delivery. Teachable mobbin:61127de5-672c-4250-984a-73e1c0684ce1; Circle mobbin:e50417f0-d6e6-4ad2-8fdc-bf7b11ff4b79; Cloudflare mobbin:2e1d62a3-dcef-49da-b7f0-83211a076b8a.

Scope and evidence: direct course/learning evidence is mixed with explicitly labeled work-management, event and booking analogues. Searches did not yield strong direct Canvas, Moodle, Google Classroom or LMS cohort-sync screenshots. Flow strips contain returned previews, so intermediate interactions may be absent. This report retains 21 references across 12 products; weak or redundant results were excluded rather than padding the requested 30–50 target. All references remain unselected for the later converge pass.

Q1

Group-as-unit enrolment (attach a group, membership stays synced) vs. copy-at-enrol

Separate selecting a group from keeping its membership synchronized. Circle [mobbin:7fccd8eb-8b47-4eba-9b29-c061ef84f911] shows existing-group member inheritance during course-space creation; Asana [mobbin:bb93bc5a-69d4-4f3e-8f70-fa48fb9b6b53] accepts teams in project-template access. Neither establishes later propagation. Basecamp [mobbin:03d638de-71a2-4fdd-a4a9-19fb51e82492] explicitly describes snapshot behavior: later group changes do not update previous assignments or mentions. For Essentials, make the chosen membership rule explicit; synchronization is a product decision requiring further validation.

Q2

Preview of impact before confirming (member count, conflicts, already enrolled)

Put the affected count beside the action. Deel [mobbin:e490327d-01e5-42c3-a4c7-c27925e5d6c1] shows 96/96 selected and a whole-team warning; Gusto [mobbin:9fb5633a-b981-4130-ac7f-bddf895856ae] reviews the learner count, completion date, reminders and per-person/total cost, with Edit links; GitBook [mobbin:bb97eec3-4564-4fab-a695-555b70cf9245] embeds the count in Add 1 member. These support count-based review, but none demonstrates duplicate resolution, already-enrolled learners, or the net-new enrollment delta. Those remain requirements to validate for overlapping semester groups.

Q3

Roster view: status, role, group origin, exceptions visible

Treat role, enrollment status, activity and group origin as different information. Circle [mobbin:3e4b87ce-37eb-41e8-af41-026d197eeccc] exposes role and activity, while Circle [mobbin:eb1701f1-73e1-45e2-a31f-80df30333517] emphasizes progress and start dates. Teachable [mobbin:3b608ec9-63a0-4e82-b915-4535ea70a9ac] offers course-filtered students and bulk operations. None shows group-origin labels or per-learner sync exceptions. Essentials still needs a decision on how a roster explains why each learner has access.

Q4

Bulk paths (CSV, code/link, integration) alongside manual add

Keep alternate entry paths next to the manual action. Teachable [mobbin:61127de5-672c-4250-984a-73e1c0684ce1] shows manual enrollment and an Import CSV tab, with the manual path selecting a course and ending in success feedback. Partiful [refero:d19d15c3-daac-4d6e-834f-a128a511a7ba] supplies a secondary CSV-template and recipient-review analogy. Circle [mobbin:e50417f0-d6e6-4ad2-8fdc-bf7b11ff4b79] also exposes CSV and link paths for member invitations. These are visible entry points; no retained flow proves LMS integration, CSV conflict handling or continuing roster sync.

Q5

Capacity / waitlist / enrolment window handling

Distinguish course limits from a full-state recovery path. Podia [mobbin:ac312350-012f-49d9-9f95-25365859a6c3] shows course start-date and sign-up-limit settings; Luma [refero:4f821362-5e07-4f2a-9a8d-a63a3330ccdb] pairs event capacity with an optional waitlist; Fresha [mobbin:13c4d86b-b5dd-446d-8451-66c17cf96e32] demonstrates collecting preferences to join a booking waitlist. The event/booking patterns are analogues. Deel [mobbin:eac0772e-c47f-4a3d-973c-f6a7352fe5a1] adds immediate/scheduled assignment and an optional deadline; Gusto [mobbin:65695f4f-db86-4ab3-b40c-e2966edd2a79] adds completion reminders and permits overdue completion. These are assignment/completion dates, not enrollment cutoffs. No reference resolves a group larger than the remaining course capacity, partial group admission, enrollment closing dates or waitlist promotion.

Q6

Notifications to learners on enrolment (seam with 07/09 — note only)

Expose notification intent at enrollment confirmation. Circle [mobbin:e50417f0-d6e6-4ad2-8fdc-bf7b11ff4b79] separates Send invites from Add without notification. Gusto [mobbin:b1497c40-cdea-4b8a-8e73-6cd70a8fcb2f] explains future course emails and learner next steps before purchase; it is a disclosure, not proof of sending. Cloudflare [mobbin:2e1d62a3-dcef-49da-b7f0-83211a076b8a] is a counter-example where a restricted skip-email option causes the invitation to fail. These screens show controls and failure feedback, not actual email delivery. Keep the course-side choice and outcome here; learner-facing access and message content remain in modules 07/09.
